decision_conditions:
The Management code shall include measures to address the following matters:
1.	The testing of equipment shall take place between the hours of 0800 and 1700 Monday to Friday only (for no more than 4 hours at a time), and not at any time on Bank Holidays.
2.	The duration of the testing to be commensurate with the test requirements, shall be minimized and shall not exceed one hour. 
3.	A list of potential residential receptors to be drawn up and those receptors to be given advance written notification of the time and date of the test.
4.       The acoustic design and control of the SPS fixed plant and equipment to meet a criterion of a rating level, measured or calculated at 1m from the façade of the nearest noise sensitive premises, of           not more than 10dB(A) above the existing background noise level (LA90).  The rating level to be determined as per the guidance provided in BS 4142:2014+A1:2019.
5.	Any noise mitigation measures to be installed.
6.	Checks, maintenance and servicing of the generators and mitigation to ensure noise levels do not increase or acoustic character such as tonality, intermittency, impulsivity or other acoustic                      character develop.
7.	Procedure for managing noise and air quality impacts from emergency use outside of testing for impacted areas of the hospital and any affected nearby residential.”
description: Erection of a new 5-storey building to accommodate an energy centre (including electrical infrastructure, plant and new emergency generators), bulk storage facilities and office accommodation, with associated access, servicing and external works. RE-CONSULTATION: THE APPLICATION REPRESENTS A DEPARTURE FROM THE DEVELOPMENT PLAN (the height of the chimney exceeds 30m and is outside of sites designated for tall buildings).
